preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call the issue() function
Attacker must have some initial USDT balance to demonstrate the accounting issue

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the issue() function to mint new tokens without proper collateral tracking. This exploits the missing accounting check that should prevent minting without corresponding collateral. The issue() function increases both the owner's balance and total supply, allowing the owner to profit from newly created tokens.
